description_excerpt: Job Description 🎁Quarter 4 JOINING BONUS Candidates with 4+ years of relevant experience who join BGSV by the end of 31 December 2026 can receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month’s gross salary, subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions. We are looking for an Automotive Diagnostic Software Engineer (1-8 Years of Experience) to join our automotive engineering team. The candidate will be involved in the development of diagnostic software solutions for modern vehicles, working with standard automotive diagnostic protocols and performing validation directly on test vehicles.…
